workflows.generate: Draft 5 LinkedIn posts for the coming week as separate ClickUp tasks in list 901818721515. Publishing schedule: Mon = Subturtle page, Wed = Subturtle page, Thu = Navid page, Fri = Subturtle page, Sat = Navid page. STEP 1: read existing tasks in this list (titles + descriptions) and note themes used in the last 30 days. STEP 2: pull current signals from Stripe (subscriptions, MRR) and Mixpanel (last 7 days: logins, word-detail views, phrase saves, practice opens, checkout opens, translation errors) — only use real numbers, never invent. STEP 3: create one task per post. Task title format: '[Day | Page] <hook>' (e.g. '[Mon | Subturtle] Why micro-learning beats a 30-min lesson'). Each task description must include: publish day and page, hook line, full post body, suggested image or 'no image', and up to 5 lowercase hashtags. Skip themes already used in the last 30 days. Follow the voice and hard rules in the playbook exactly.
